item.title: What Is AI Visibility (and Why Your Business Is Invisible to ChatGPT)
item.description: AI visibility is whether AI assistants recommend your business. We asked an AI assistant 35 unbranded questions in our own industry — our business appeared in zero. Here is what the metric means, how it is measured, and the levers that move it.
